summary: Kootenai National Forest lookout in Lincoln County, MT, built 1940 with an L-4 cab; abandoned since the 1970s, with its cab collapsed by 2017.

facts.status_note: Abandoned since the 1970s; the cab had collapsed by 2017 (firelookout.com)

access.note: Reached on foot from a forest road to the trailhead; no closure or private land described in the sources read. The collapsed cab is not a place to climb.

visit.trail_note: Trail 299 about 2.7 miles to Divide Trail 6, then an unmarked spur to the summit (SummitPost)

events.note: Built as a wooden tower with L-4 cab, replacing an earlier camp
John M. Richards manned the lookout in the summers of 1944 and 1945, during World War II
USGS topographic map portrayed in 1966 (published 1971) marks a lookout tower on the peak, as described by Pastmaps
Abandoned 'since the 1970s'; the sources give a decade, not an exact year
Registered April 7, 2011 as US 905, MT 53; nominated by John M. Richards
Cab had collapsed by 2017, per firelookout.com

notes_for_editor: Built 1940 and NHLR registration (2011) match the record. The record's height_m 3.0 is not confirmed: the sources give only "10' wooden tower", with no clear unit, so the height is left out of facts. Abandonment is given only as 'since the 1970s', so the 1970 event year is a decade marker, not a dated event. The 1966 map is described on Pastmaps (a generated description of the map); the map itself was not read. A 1956 Daily Inter Lake item quoted on montanalookouts.weebly.com places a William Justis 'on Barren Peak' but does not say he was at a lookout, so it is omitted. No photos were added; NHLR photos already in the record. Access 'public' is inferred from the hiking route and absence of any closure in the sources read; the record had access 'unknown'.
